column1: # CURATED MPF_F anchor set. Read off the five MPF_F seeds by scanning all annotated
# CDS against the whole of Pfam-A at GA (scripts/103_mpf_anchor_readout.py), never
# transferred from MPF_T and never taken from a family NAME.
# INDEXED BY ACCESSION, NOT GENE NAME, and this is load-bearing: PF10412/PF12696
# (TrwB/T4CP) hit F traD and R27 traG, while PF07916 (the VirB6 analogue) hits F
# traG. So `traG` means VirB6 in F and a coupling protein in R27. Name-indexing
# would merge a channel component with a T4CP.
# All 13 hit ALL FIVE seeds (F, R100, IncC/pVCR94, SXT, R27), so MPF_F does NOT
# need to be split into F-like and HI-like anchor sets. R27 is the lowest score in
# almost every row -- a divergent member of the same families, consistent with its
# chimera label -- but it is detected by every one of them.
# Sharing families is NOT sharing gene order. R27 keeps Tra1 and Tra2 as separate
# regions, so per-lineage ARCHITECTURE calls are still required, exactly as
# canonical vs rearranged was for MPF_T.
# PF00589 (Phage_integrase) also hits 5/5 and is deliberately EXCLUDED: it is not a
# skeleton component, it is there because these elements are ICEs.

column9: SOLE entry filter, measured across all 72,558 cached accessions: admits 11,120 (15.4%), all 5 seeds at GA, 93% of admissions independently called MPF_F by MOB-suite. Chosen as the VirB4 HOMOLOG, i.e. the structural counterpart of the MPF_T criterion -- NOT because it is the most conservative. Ranking by fewest admissions was the first (wrong) criterion applied: it would have picked F_T4SS_TraN (10,866; a DOMAIN model at 39.8% median target coverage) or TrbC_Ftype (10,884; a pilin, and the measured two-tier structure puts pilus components in the high-failure tier at VirB2 20.9%). An entry filter decides what can never be seen, so the bias direction matters more than 237 plasmids. Trade-off recorded: TraC_F_IV admits ~400 plasmids TrbC_Ftype misses and misses ~164 it catches (Jaccard 0.950); and TraE recovers 94.3% of MOB-suite's MPF_F against TraC_F_IV's 88.7%, which would win if third-party recall were the criterion -- it is not, MOB-suite being coarser and not ground truth
